profile.org_note: Clayton Properties Group (CPG) is the site-built arm of Clayton Home Building Group, which sits under Clayton Homes (CEO Kevin Clayton), a wholly owned Berkshire Hathaway company. Clayton Home Building Group CEO Keith Holdbrooks and COO Colt Davis (Chairman of CPG, Inc.) sit above CPG; Mike Rutherford is President of CPG, Inc. and leads its acquisitions. Each acquired brand keeps its own leadership (brand CEO/president, division or market presidents and its own land team, e.g. Summit's VP of Land & Development and Elite's VP of Land Acquisition and Development), so land is bought brand by brand. No CPG-level head of land or treasury is published; group finance sits with Clayton CFO Jim Stariha, and Clayton set up an in-house land bank (about $182 million, reported January 2024). Since 24 July 2026 Taylor Morrison CEO Sheryl Palmer oversees integrating CPG with Taylor Morrison, and several CPG brand sites say they will join Taylor Morrison in 2027, so land and finance decisions are likely moving to Taylor Morrison's team (inference).
profile.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's site-built homebuilder: about 10,000 homes in 2025 (9,953 closings, #12 on the 2026 Builder 100) through roughly 13 to 15 acquired regional brands in about 17 states, with about 67,300 homesites owned and controlled and a $1.2 billion backlog at end-2025. It is funded inside Berkshire (no public debt) and keeps buying builders (McGuinn Homes, July 2026). Berkshire bought Taylor Morrison in July 2026 and is merging the two into one site-built platform under Sheryl Palmer, so CPG's land strategy is likely to follow Taylor Morrison's, which already uses third-party land banks.

people.note: Official 2026 Texas report lists him as President/Director of the legal entity (Maryville, TN; the entity also does business as Brohn Homes in Texas). Builder's firm page (archived 2026-07-21) names him CEO of Clayton Properties Group. HousingWire (2026-07-01) says he was the Clayton executive who met McGuinn's founder to agree the McGuinn Homes deal, so he is the senior deal-maker for CPG acquisitions. Reporting line to Clayton Home Building Group CEO Keith Holdbrooks is inferred from Clayton's structure (CPG sits under Home Building Group on Clayton's site), not stated. Since July 2026 Taylor Morrison CEO Sheryl Palmer oversees integrating CPG with Taylor Morrison, so his role may change. Title note: Listed by Builder as CEO of Clayton Properties Group.

people.title: Chief Executive Officer, Taylor Morrison
people.source_title: Berkshire Hathaway press release: Berkshire Hathaway completes acquisition of Taylor Morrison
people.note: Not a CPG employee. Berkshire's release says she will oversee integrating Taylor Morrison's brands with Berkshire's site-built operations that comprise Clayton Properties Group (15 regional and local builders), and Berkshire CEO Greg Abel says Taylor Morrison will lead a unified site-built platform. On 2026-11-19 the Mungo, Summit, Goodall and Legacy Homes sites carry a banner saying the brand is joining Taylor Morrison in 2027. Land and land-finance decisions for CPG builders may move to Taylor Morrison's Scottsdale team (inference, not a company statement); see the taylor-morrison file for that team. Title note: Overseeing integration of Clayton Properties Group with Taylor Morrison (Berkshire Hathaway).
